name: Spatially Encoded Radiance Fields
definition: A class of radiance field methods that simplify the implicit radiance function by spatially decomposing it into smaller functions to reduce the complexity load on the MLP.
summary: Spatially Encoded Radiance Fields accelerate rendering by storing features in a 3D voxel grid and using a small MLP, replacing heavy coordinate-based mapping with a lookup-and-decode pipeline.
